output.headline: Sponsor with prior deals in the target's own sub-sector, a Midwest precedent, and a history of paying above the comparable range.
output.differentiator: Its median 17.1x paid sits above the comparable 75th percentile of 15.3x, and it has bought in the target's own sub-sector and the Midwest. Peer comparison not available here. [T:record, V:comps]
output.why_them: Sponsor that pays upper-quartile; bought in our sub-sector and the Midwest

acquirer_overview.title: Large financial sponsor with a decade of control deals
points: Financial sponsor; Private Equity segment held $416.4 billion of Total Assets Under Management as of December 31, 2025 [P:1].
25 deals from 2015 to 2024, 22 closed; 23 of 25 were control deals; median deal $342M [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Seventh on the priority list of 10, with a likelihood of 4.3%; most deals (16) fall outside provider services [R:rank, T:record].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Own-sub-sector precedents and platform-building history support the fit
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors and past deal count are each a modest factor in its likelihood [S:sector_rel, S:activity].
Platform Build was a motive in 9 of 25 deals, well above the 23% share across all deals in the file [M:platform_build].
2 deals in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; no open platform in the sub-sector, so a new platform bet [T:record, A:angles].

precedent_activity.title: Two Healthcare Services deals in 2021, one in the Midwest
points: Peak Medical Management: $342M SPAC Merger, 2021, Midwest, at 10.0x EV/EBITDA, closed [D:MA-2021-0407].
Evergreen Care Solutions: $299M Bolt-on Acquisition, 2021, Southwest, at 14.6x, closed [D:MA-2021-0195].
Adjacent dental: Crest Oral Health, $558M Leveraged Buyout, 2021, at 13.5x; North Smile Group, $222M, 2021, at 13.5x [D:MA-2021-0164, D:MA-2021-0453].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; return at the ask falls short
points: 70 comparable deals show 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median and 15.3x at the 75th; we defend the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Target margin of 16.8% sits above the comps' median of 12.9% and above 87% of comps; Blackstone's own median paid is 17.1x [V:comps].
At 5.0x leverage and a $128M equity cheque, IRR at the ask is 18.7% against a 20% target [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: At the same exit the maximum price is $193M, so the bid needs a platform-exit case [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Regional footprint
risk_flags.concern: Having bought in this or a neighbouring region is a slight factor against it [S:geo_fit].
risk_flags.mitigant: Peak Medical Management was a Midwest deal in the target's own sub-sector [D:MA-2021-0407].
risk_flags.reality: Only 2 of 25 deals were in the Midwest [T:record].

risk_flags.title: Provider focus and platform
risk_flags.concern: 16 of 25 deals were outside provider services, and there is no open platform in the sub-sector [T:record, A:angles].
risk_flags.mitigant: It has 2 deals in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors [T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Provider deals are 9 of 25, so the target would be a new platform [A:angles].

conviction.rationale: Support is 2 deals in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; neutral is the absence of an open platform in the sub-sector. [C:conviction]
